classification_note: Partial means executable foundations exist but at least one accepted rule, parity detail or production gate remains. This is not a whole-game percentage.

requirements.title: Dormitory-focused dystopia, reference architecture, lobby and crowded galleries
requirements.implemented: Deep shaft, bunk banks, lobby and configurable footprints exist.
requirements.remaining: Large vacant floor areas and repeated interiors need the reference-density pass.
requirements.procedure: Inspect a default lobby, residential gallery and commercial floor at eye height, day and night; walk every connecting route.
requirements.pass_condition: Crowding and architecture match the recorded references while all occupied areas remain supported and reachable.

requirements.title: Configurable 2,000-floor / 100,000-resident world; 512 m standard and 640 m entrance footprints
requirements.implemented: Default and independent floor/lobby dimensions, seed/population and paid extensions execute.
requirements.remaining: Large-world usable density and measured scaling are not accepted yet.
requirements.procedure: Generate defaults and alternate dimensions; save/reload; expand an occupied floor with a funded crew.
requirements.pass_condition: 2,000 floors/100,000 identities and 512/640 m defaults persist; expansion consumes actual materials/work without moving existing titles.

requirements.title: Uneven residential, service, office and commercial floors; scarce interactive facilities
requirements.implemented: Residential/service/commercial generation and usable typed businesses exist.
requirements.remaining: Complete layout editing and production population of the footprint remain.
requirements.procedure: Visit housing-only, service and commercial floors; attempt each service with valid and missing staff, supplies and access.
requirements.pass_condition: Uneven scarcity is visible; every advertised usable facility performs its actual action or explains its real unavailable prerequisite.

requirements.title: Continuous locomotion, queues, ladders, safe support, sleeping on beds and fitness
requirements.implemented: Continuous walking/climbing, bed poses, queues, falls and fitness execute.
requirements.remaining: Comprehensive contacts, general crowd recovery and production contact animation remain.
requirements.procedure: Walk/run through a crowd; queue; climb and dismount; sleep in both bunks; jump/fall; reload during movement.
requirements.pass_condition: No unsupported standing, body penetration, teleportation or camera shaking; injuries, fitness and poses agree with physical state.

requirements.title: Survival, Manager, Cheat, possession/inspection, AI owner and ownership takeover
requirements.implemented: Three modes, possession/free camera, owner succession and bounded resident cheats execute.
requirements.remaining: Cheat world/entity editing and complete mode UI remain.
requirements.procedure: Start each mode, switch permitted viewpoints, inspect/possess, edit a supported rule, then reload.
requirements.pass_condition: Survival presents essentials; Manager has owner authority; Cheat supports the complete bounded editor without corrupting accounts.

requirements.title: Move-in/out, death/empty-world game over, retirement and succession
requirements.implemented: Arrival/departure, death/empty-population ends, voluntary sale and retirement exist.
requirements.remaining: Complete physical takeover and succession consequences require final play acceptance.
requirements.procedure: Move in; depart in Survival/Manager; empty a world; refuse a sale; trigger retirement and a contested takeover.
requirements.pass_condition: Correct runs end with explained causes; refusal is real and successor/contested ownership preserves existing obligations.

requirements.title: Named slots, backups, recovery, migrations and browser feature parity
requirements.implemented: Versioned native slots, metadata, backup recovery and bounded browser conversion execute.
requirements.remaining: Archived family/history/rules are not native continuation; full migration matrix is unverified.
requirements.procedure: Load native and browser fixtures, finish prepaid work, save a separate named slot, corrupt its primary and recover the backup.
requirements.pass_condition: Identities, property, escrow, active tasks and required browser behaviour continue once without losing the source.

requirements.title: Stable identities, age/personality/preferences and English/French/Chinese display names
requirements.implemented: Stable IDs, three name forms, aggression and preferences exist.
requirements.remaining: Family/age lifecycle and modular visible age/personality variety remain.
requirements.procedure: Follow the same resident through language switches, relationships, age milestones, clothing changes and reload.
requirements.pass_condition: All references retain identity and appropriate age/personality choices; no duplicate or substituted resident is created.

requirements.title: Complete Chinese, English and French UI, text input and readable layouts
requirements.implemented: Matching EN/FR/ZH catalogues and native text rendering execute.
requirements.remaining: Chinese composition, complete input/remapping and full-size/layout QA remain.
requirements.procedure: In each language enter/search a name using relevant keyboard/IME; exercise every screen at small and large supported sizes.
requirements.pass_condition: Names and controls remain readable, editable and reachable without clipping, hidden buttons or broken focus.

requirements.title: Independent schedules, night shifts, sleep, meals, work, school and leisure
requirements.implemented: Day/night shifts, needs, sleep, service choices and limited training exist.
requirements.remaining: Deeper planning, dependents, qualifications and long-run schedule balance remain.
requirements.procedure: Observe day workers, night workers, students and carers for several days; remove their normal service or workplace.
requirements.pass_condition: Actors visibly attend real activities, sleep on beds and replan needs/commutes without permanent task-failure loops.

requirements.title: Communication, relationships, households, families and dependent care
requirements.implemented: Nearby talks, shared trust, adult households, real meal aid and device messages exist.
requirements.remaining: Event memory/rivalry/information decisions and native dependent families remain.
requirements.procedure: Build friendship, cause a grievance, communicate a witnessed fact, form a consenting household and interrupt a care errand.
requirements.pass_condition: History changes later choices; only acquired information is known and real family/care commitments survive interruption/reload.

requirements.title: Personal items, shared/private storage, provisioning, wear, washing and clothes changes
requirements.implemented: Owned/carried items, consent-based lockers, tableware/cookers, laundry and spare outfits execute.
requirements.remaining: Broader provisioning, movable contacts and modular paid wear/customization remain.
requirements.procedure: Purchase and deliver supplies; store/share/retrieve them; cook, wash and change clothes; attempt unauthorized access.
requirements.pass_condition: Each item has one title/location; reservations, dirt/wear and ownership remain valid after theft, cancellation and reload.

requirements.title: Own/buy/rent/sell homes and possessions; theft and robbery consequences
requirements.implemented: Homes/businesses and personal resale transfer real money/title; theft/recovery exists.
requirements.remaining: Complete negotiation, parking/fleet decisions and cause-based consequences remain.
requirements.procedure: Rent/buy/list/sell an occupied home and a personal item; attempt theft; recover property through real custody.
requirements.pass_condition: Leases, meeting distance, consent, payment and provenance prevent free transfers or remote handovers.

requirements.title: Food, water, toilets, showers, sinks, laundry, waste and repair facilities
requirements.implemented: Food/water/toilet/bathing/laundry/waste/repair/washing services execute.
requirements.remaining: Fuller physical interiors, daily-life coverage and disaster cleanup remain.
requirements.procedure: Visit all daily-life services; exhaust staff, stock and waste capacity; close/reopen and repair a service.
requirements.pass_condition: Unstaffed or unsupplied services stop appropriately; unattended permitted services continue; no stock or sanitation disappears for free.

requirements.title: Sparse pools, arcades, playgrounds, cinemas, gardens, libraries, gyms and preference-driven recreation
requirements.implemented: Sparse typed recreation and preference-sensitive visits exist.
requirements.remaining: Density, venue variety and coupled happiness/scarcity tuning need acceptance.
requirements.procedure: Give contrasting preferences access to a cinema, food venue, gym/pool and shop with differing queues/prices.
requirements.pass_condition: Residents choose explainably different affordable activities; recreation uses actual capacity and affects happiness.

requirements.title: Long real queues, capacity, prices, supplies, opening hours, workers and interruptions
requirements.implemented: Visible tails, station reservations, shift gates, hours, prices and interruptions execute.
requirements.remaining: General congestion recovery and whole-economy queue balance remain.
requirements.procedure: Join/cut a scarce service line; remove a worker; resume a prepaid visit; block and later clear the route.
requirements.pass_condition: Physical queue order and paid progress persist, cutting can cause consequences, and benign changes do not duplicate charges or strand tasks.

requirements.title: Conserved accounts, migration capital, happiness and causal economic failure
requirements.implemented: Conserved transfers, external sources/sinks, wages, migration and business accounts execute.
requirements.remaining: Complete multi-day autonomous investment and adversarial economy balancing remain.
requirements.procedure: Track every account while residents arrive/leave, buy/work/build, die, receive refunds and suffer shortages.
requirements.pass_condition: Internal changes net to zero except explicit external entries; happiness/migration and game over follow actual economic conditions.

requirements.title: Property premiums based on actual service/job/transport access, crowding, risk and condition
requirements.implemented: Basic nearby-service housing premiums and retained leases execute.
requirements.remaining: Actual queue/fare/noise/risk/condition pricing and contested succession remain.
requirements.procedure: Compare equivalent homes before/after service closure, transport access changes, crowding and damage; keep an active lease.
requirements.pass_condition: Price changes reflect measured accessibility/conditions and never rewrite an existing lease by accident.

requirements.title: Live layout editing, beds/facilities/floors, expansion, planners, foremen and paid construction
requirements.implemented: Funded walls, bed/floor work, expansions, materials and cooperative crews execute.
requirements.remaining: Partial slabs, arbitrary supported layouts, company workflows and structural consequences remain.
requirements.procedure: Plan a mixed interior, partial slab edit and extension; survey, quote, fund, deliver, build, cancel and reopen.
requirements.pass_condition: Preview and actual geometry/nav/support agree; site access, paid work and real materials gate progress and payer title.

requirements.title: Ownership/leases, compensation, negotiation, physical eviction, resistance and casualties
requirements.implemented: Owner checks, tenant consent, compensation and bounded forced bed relocation execute.
requirements.remaining: Complete notices, negotiation, displacement and physical enforcement workflows remain.
requirements.procedure: Attempt ordinary and forced projects on rented, owned, shared-storage and commercial spaces with insufficient funds/refusal.
requirements.pass_condition: Rights and funded compensation are preserved; forced action requires actual actors and can cause resistance/crime/casualties.

requirements.title: Companies, workspace, hiring, team direction, jobs, wages, investment and real profit
requirements.implemented: Companies, leased workspaces, payroll/debt, leader assignments, shares and expansions execute.
requirements.remaining: Full role/minigame, merger, insolvency and AI investment loops remain.
requirements.procedure: Found/rent/staff a company, assign work, meet a client contract, pay wages and grow or default.
requirements.pass_condition: Profit comes from completed funded work, workspace and authority stay valid, and losses/claims persist across ownership changes.

requirements.title: Meaningful programming, administration and video-editing work
requirements.implemented: Programming transforms datasets, admin handles real dispatch tickets, video scores clip order.
requirements.remaining: A real trimming timeline and deeper distinct discipline tasks remain.
requirements.procedure: Play each discipline against a concrete brief; submit poor/good revisions, delegate and miss a deadline.
requirements.pass_condition: Controls and scoring are discipline-specific; actual quality, time, staffing and client funds determine settlement.

requirements.title: Actual delivery, construction, sanitation, repair, retail, teaching, medicine, piloting and security work
requirements.implemented: Core courier, builder, cleaner, medic, pilot, security and repair actions execute.
requirements.remaining: Every accepted physical role needs complete player/NPC, interruption and presentation acceptance.
requirements.procedure: Play each physical job from paid offer to pickup/tools, travel, on-site action, delivery/result and wages; interrupt it mid-route.
requirements.pass_condition: No timer awards remote work; people, equipment, client goods and funds reach their actual required places exactly once.

requirements.title: Staffed education, school schedules, learning and career qualifications
requirements.implemented: Staffed paid attendance, three exercise subjects and saved skills execute.
requirements.remaining: Child curricula, qualifications and promotion progression remain.
requirements.procedure: Attend/teach school with capacity/material/staff limits, finish exercises, miss lessons and apply a qualification to work.
requirements.pass_condition: Knowledge requires real attendance/results and affects legitimate opportunities; absent teaching cannot grant a diploma.

requirements.title: Devices, paid public/work computers and polished simulated DORMNET commerce/messages/work/news
requirements.implemented: Device/paid terminal access, shopping, messages, real deliveries and business pages execute.
requirements.remaining: Complete device-specific DORMNET, input and integration polish remain.
requirements.procedure: Use owned phone/laptop, employee computer and paid public terminal; lose access during work/order/message actions.
requirements.pass_condition: Access and charges are real; offline/remote access does not fabricate information, stock or delivery and screens stay usable.

requirements.title: Melee/firearms, injuries/fatigue, surrender, lethal choices and causal falling/shoving
requirements.implemented: Melee/firearms, intervening hits, fatigue, surrender, gravity and causal falls execute.
requirements.remaining: Full contacts, injury depth, threat/personality choices and production feedback remain.
requirements.procedure: Fight, defend, surrender, execute, shove and fall with cover/bystanders, then seek care and reload.
requirements.pass_condition: Hits respect reach/support, helpless killing is severe, injuries affect action and culpability persists.

requirements.title: Witness-based responsibility, self-defence, investigations, arrests, cells, escapes and police misconduct
requirements.implemented: Observed reports, last-seen search, escorts, intake, escapes and recovered goods execute.
requirements.remaining: Lockable cells, standalone restraints, richer evidence/search and misuse consequences remain.
requirements.procedure: Report witnessed/unwitnessed offences, investigate, arrest/escort, book into a real cell, escape/rescue and recover property.
requirements.pass_condition: Unknown facts stay unknown; every arrest/custody/escape uses actual actors, cell space and known evidence.

requirements.title: Internal infirmaries, staffed care, ambulance hangars/crews, paid tiers and armed response
requirements.implemented: Internal clinics, real flying ambulances, staff and paid tiers/guards execute.
requirements.remaining: Complete diagnosis, staffed hangars, coordinated armed response and capacity feedback remain.
requirements.procedure: Dispatch each tier under active violence, missing crews/fuel/space and traffic; treat after physical handover.
requirements.pass_condition: Tier priority improves real available response, never instant rescue; equipment/staff/payment and patient location remain causal.

requirements.title: Real corpse pickup, capacity-limited morgues and cremation with costs/sanitation
requirements.implemented: Actual remains, carry/store/cremate, capacity, staffing and estates execute.
requirements.remaining: Full sanitation/family effects, contacts/animation and disaster recovery remain.
requirements.procedure: Find a body, notify workers, transport to a full/available morgue, cremate with supplies and settle the estate.
requirements.pass_condition: One body and one title/debt history persist; no remote disposal, duplicated inheritance or unpaid cremation.

requirements.title: Rare disease/accidents, fire, smoke, property damage and disaster response
requirements.implemented: Infection/immunity, local/connected-floor fire, smoke, goods/cargo loss and paid response execute.
requirements.remaining: Ventilation/doors, construction/vehicle fire damage, structural failure and cleanup remain.
requirements.procedure: Cause a rare bounded outbreak/fire, operate barriers, evacuate, lose goods, treat casualties, clean and fund repairs.
requirements.pass_condition: Traceable hazards respect geometry; losses, response and recovery consume real resources and never replace assets for free.

requirements.title: Expensive vehicles, stores, scarce paid parking, permission, fuel and maintenance
requirements.implemented: Owned vehicles/dealers, scarce bays, fuel, condition, repair and physical towing execute.
requirements.remaining: Rolling/suspension, fuller damage/contacts, enforcement and autonomous fleets remain.
requirements.procedure: Buy with/without parking, drive loaded, collide/run out of fuel, request repair/tow and attempt an unauthorized drive.
requirements.pass_condition: Purchase grants no free space; handling/load/permission matter and paid physical work recovers the actual vehicle.

requirements.title: Physical ramps, selected-floor paid/subscribed lifts, transport queues and towing
requirements.implemented: Selected paid lifts, calls/capacity, ramps/freight platforms and continuous towing execute.
requirements.remaining: General traffic/contacts/congestion and fuller operator interaction remain.
requirements.procedure: Queue at a sparse paid lift, board/ride/exit, take a loaded vehicle over a ramp/platform and interrupt/cancel transport.
requirements.pass_condition: Fares/subscriptions/whitelists and capacity apply; no teleportation, clipped support or duplicated occupancy.

requirements.title: Custom C++ engine, Vulkan, suitable GPU parallel work and CPU/software fallback
requirements.implemented: Custom C++ engine/Vulkan, GPU instances/skinning and CPU/headless/software paths execute.
requirements.remaining: Broad suitable simulation offload, streaming budgets and platform validation remain.
requirements.procedure: Run supported hardware and CPU presets on the same dense world; compare rules and profile parallel workloads.
requirements.pass_condition: Both paths preserve validated simulation/accounting; documented performance and responsiveness budgets are measured.

requirements.title: Licensed assets, multiple formats, modular people/clothes/beds/closets/vehicles
requirements.implemented: glTF/GLB/OBJ and PBR assets have provenance; tint/style configuration exists.
requirements.remaining: Modular paid components and robust full import/animation/customization pipeline remain.
requirements.procedure: Load each supported format and malformed input; fit/modify owned people, beds, closets and vehicles through paid work.
requirements.pass_condition: Imports fail clearly; licensed components persist, alter visible geometry and obey ownership rather than free palette-only upgrades.

requirements.title: Good lighting/materials/shadows, stable rendering and polished interaction animation
requirements.implemented: PBR, shadows/lights, procedural blended poses, body clothing snapshots and smoke execute.
requirements.remaining: Reference art, contact IK, imported animation, final lighting and motion stability remain.
requirements.procedure: Inspect all reference scenes in motion while walking, climbing, sleeping, using tools, fighting and carrying.
requirements.pass_condition: Good lighting/material scale and correct contacts remain stable under camera rotation and interruption.

requirements.title: Production UI, sound, input/accessibility and platform-ready packaging
requirements.implemented: Minimal Survival drawer, saved controls/audio, procedural sound and Linux packages execute.
requirements.remaining: Complete polished UI/input/IME/accessibility, sound acoustics and Windows validation remain.
requirements.procedure: Use complete loops with keyboard/mouse at supported sizes/languages, mute/unplug audio, relocate install and recover saves.
requirements.pass_condition: Critical controls remain discoverable/reachable, cues work without audio, and supported clean player installs need no compiler.

requirements.title: Shares, acquisitions, deeper company finance, insolvency and personal/corporate inheritance
requirements.implemented: Conserved shares/dividends, voted subsidiary acquisition and personal/simple corporate succession execute.
requirements.remaining: Negotiated legal mergers, insolvency/liquidation and contested estates remain.
requirements.procedure: Trade/finance/merge businesses, default with creditors, die with disputed assets and receive a late refund.
requirements.pass_condition: Authority/claims/assets transfer once with priority, consent and actual funds; debts and leases never disappear.

requirements.title: Finished playable loops, long-run scarcity balance, supported hardware and shipping quality
requirements.implemented: Bounded native/rendered/memory checks and portable development candidates exist.
requirements.remaining: Full scenario acceptance, multi-seed long runs, measured hardware and final release gates remain.
requirements.procedure: Run the M30 seed matrix, M31 whole-game scenarios and M32 clean-install release procedure against the exact candidate.
requirements.pass_condition: All accepted gates pass with retained evidence, no P0/P1 defect remains and the exact shipped packages are verified.

browser_parity.feature: Identity, names, wallets and home titles
browser_parity.policy: IDs/title holders remain stable; native names gain EN/FR forms. Continue normal native accounts without replaying historical money.

browser_parity.feature: Facility types, stock, queues and prepaid service
browser_parity.policy: All 14 browser facility kinds map natively; queue order and remaining prepaid work are retained without charging twice.
Six legacy items and their ownership/listings convert; actual native household use replaces the browser activity scheduler.
Native schedules replace browser markers; dependent family/school progression still needs completion.

browser_parity.feature: Free-floor camera, possession, ladder interaction and physical queues
browser_parity.policy: Native equivalents execute; complete collision/input/help and presentation acceptance remain.
Age at conversion is retained; kin/partner records are archived. No active native family lifecycle exists.

browser_parity.feature: Pregnancy, fertility, birth event and newborn care
browser_parity.policy: Pregnancy/birth records and experimental fertility survive only in browserArchive; no native scheduled birth continues.

browser_parity.feature: Friendship encounter counts and social needs
browser_parity.policy: Encounter counts become bounded trust; original social state/history is archived and richer event memory remains.

browser_parity.feature: Earned/spent, causes, marriages/birth/death totals and time-series statistics
browser_parity.policy: Historical counters/logs are archived rather than mapped to native analytics; restore as history without posting money twice.
Original parameters remain archived; native policies/cheats do not yet expose every equivalent rule.
No bit-identical cross-engine schedule replay is promised. The native engine regenerates routes and clocks; preserve required gameplay outcomes and identities.
Browser StatisticsPanel exports CSV; the native summary does not yet provide the same history chart/export workflow.
Explicitly cancelled by later user revisions. Do not implement their legacy visuals as release blockers.
Native named slots/backups/time controls exist; match safe autosave and cancellable long-run workflow, not browser storage APIs.

scope_rules: All 38 requirements and 14 parity rows belong to existing M00–M32; no extra milestone was introduced.
Family scope is the retained browser lifecycle plus causal dependent care, not an unlimited family-law simulator.
Evidence/search, structural integrity and smoke are bounded gameplay models; scientific fluid simulation, an entire court system and deformable car bodies are not additional release blockers.
Preserve historical browser counters as labelled pre-conversion history; never replay their transactions into native balances.
Platform claims require real validation. Linux is primary; Windows remains a recorded plan gate, not verified support.
